C_COD_FURTHER_PROBLEMS.rationale: Beyond the required cases and credited robustness gaps, the candidate identifies that the function silently ignores all elements after the first when multiple coupon codes are supplied, stating this further problem loosely.

C_COD_WHO_IS_AFFECTED.rationale: The response identifies the monetary defect in the formula and notes that the business unintentionally loses money on negative amounts, but it fails to evaluate the second production test case (which results in zero), omitting that zero settlement fails silently and leaves the seller completely unpaid.
